atom_membership: An atom must fit wholly inside the selected formation span, bracket and applicable initial-balance boundary. A causal event cursor must be applied to original source order before creating the first atom; no coarse-bar inclusion is substituted.
atom_scope: All roots, raw IDs, physical contracts, source acquisition lineages, delay scenarios and ordered physical addresses match explicitly. An overlap or failed constituent poisons that calculation.
bar_profiles: Reuse the retained pure source allocation formulas: equal inclusive rows, continuous overlap, PIN066 source/corrected, close and HLC3. Priced volume allocated; unpriced volume retained separately; source flat-bar lost mass explicit. Bar-derived side is a proxy, not reported aggression.
initial_balance: Elapsed 30/60 minutes from the first declared span start; the first span must contain the entire intended interval. Preserve provisional and no-volume results and exact actual high/low clocks/orders.
pin069: Initialize on the first supported completed bar and reset on a new observed high only for a bar whose start lies inside the disclosed fixed UTC-4 06–09 window. Weight its close by full bar volume. Keep earlier geometric bar origin and later publication. Unsupported high state is not cleared by an ordinary later bar; selection-history incompleteness remains explicit.
resource_check_scope: Complete measured resource-window composition and representations; no full-cohort statistics, annual cost extrapolation, predictive quality or Location-quality completion.
rolling: Two-stack FIFO ordered path composition; exact sparse side-mass additions/removals. Trimming updates membership without publishing or recomputing geometry. Missing elapsed intervals remain missing. Quantiles of constituent quantiles are never formed.
tpo_brackets: Restart at each declared disjoint formation span; actual priced-trade row membership is a bitset of stable bracket ordinals. The separate OHLC-range proxy fills between the complete observed bracket minimum/maximum.
tpo_single_prints: Geometric final single prints require complete intended formation and at least two complete brackets. Preserve the existing five-complete-bracket source-display criterion as a separate comparator.
